faces.name: Opposition Agent

effect.reason: No continuous effect grants one player control of another player (CR 720). ControlBy changes control of an object, not of a player, and there is no record for a control effect that lasts only while a player is performing a search.
effect.text: You control your opponents while they're searching their libraries.

abilities.text: You control your opponents while they're searching their libraries.

effect.reason: Nothing replaces the cards a search finds with an exile (the Searches trigger fires after the search and cannot alter what it found), and no record grants a play permission for those exiled cards for as long as they remain exiled, nor 'spend mana as though it were mana of any color'.
effect.text: While an opponent is searching their library, they exile each card they find. You may play those cards for as long as they remain exiled, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast them.
